text: My office received a petition from community members requesting the installation of an all-way stop control at the intersection of Golfview Avenue and Duvernet Avenue. Residents believe this measure will increase pedestrian safety at this busy intersection. We have met with Transportation Services staff who support this initiative.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory all-way stop control at the intersection of Golfview Avenue and Duvernet Avenue.
